title: Oil Plummets and Gold Surges After US-Iran Military Pause
summary: Silver, yen, and some Asian stock markets also benefit from the Gulf truce, while crude oil prices register their biggest drop in months.

title: Semiconductor and Tech Stocks Plunge Worldwide Over Fears of Excessive AI Spending

summary: The Dow Jones and S&P 500 close with slight gains while the Nasdaq retreats, in a session marked by anticipation of big companies' earnings and cheaper crude oil.

summary: The iPhone maker takes advantage of the sharp fall in Nvidia's shares due to the chip sector crisis to regain the top spot in market capitalization.

summary: The pharmaceutical giant reaches a deal to close thousands of complaints linking its baby products to ovarian cancer and mesothelioma.

title: Markets Expect Fed to Hold Interest Rates at Next Meeting
summary: Despite the recent rebound in crude oil and inflationary pressures, most analysts rule out a rate hike at the July FOMC meeting.

title: Indonesia's Central Bank Governor Unexpectedly Resigns
summary: Perry Warjiyo resigns as head of the Indonesian monetary authority amid volatility in local financial markets, and the government calls for calm and guarantees an orderly transition.

title: Chinese Chipmaker CXMT Soars 466% on Stock Market Debut

title: Ibex 35 Hits New All-Time Highs Fueled by Oil Slump
